decks.summary: Introductory Hemlock Vale Wilson with a path from 0 to 40 XP: Chainsaws, Fingerprint Kit, Microscope and Old Keyring on a Tool Belt, Matchboxes and Fire Extinguisher, with Ad Hoc and Tinker.
Cluever Wilson who builds an asset-heavy table of Lockpicks, Magnifying Glass, Fingerprint Kit and Thieves' Kit on Tool Belts to investigate at 5 from his second turn.
Balanced flex Wilson with Sledgehammers, Fingerprint Kits and Flashlights, Cleaning Kits and Fire Extinguishers, and Stand Together; the guide also covers cluever and fighter builds.
Solo toolbox Wilson who treats his hand slots as disposable: Flashlight, Lantern and Old Keyring for clues, Pitchforks and Sledgehammers thrown at enemies, and Pushed to the Limit to reuse them.

Ancient Evils' level 0 Wilson updated after a Hemlock Vale run: Old Keyrings, Fingerprint Kit and Microscope for clues, Pitchforks and Gravedigger's Shovels for enemies, and Tinker and Ad Hoc for slots.
True solo Hemlock Vale lumberjack Wilson who fights hard with Enchanted Blade and Pitchforks, finds clues with Flashlight and Old Keyring, and keeps Tetsuo Mori and Wolf Mask for safety.
Two-box Wilson building toward a Shotgun with Cleaning Kit (3), using Tinker and Occult Reliquary to solve slot problems, with Flashlight and Magnifying Glass for clues.
Fire Extinguisher Wilson who reuses the Extinguisher forever through Pushed to the Limit to beat non-elite enemies at 7 and exhaust bosses, with Taunt and Guard Dogs.
Innsmouth and Hemlock two-box Wilson who enchants communal Pitchforks and Hatchets so teammates hit with his willpower, backed by Katanas, Machetes and Beat Cops.
Asset-heavy flex Wilson built around a fully upgraded Pocket Multi Tool, Geared Up for a fast start, and Chemistry Set, Lantern and Hatchets covering clues and enemies.
